title: The Melody Men and the band at Legends Dance Hall
summary: Johnny McDonald's group and the current four-piece at Legends, with sitters-in.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Either that or jump over with one or two. Yeah. Been up there a long time with Johnny McDone. We used to call ourselves the Melody Man. We just spot around. We had a nice set up there. Good old band. And then after the band broke up, and then we started to play over at, let's see, at the Legends Dance Hall, that one, Charles and Mary. All they have is four men there. That's Bill Mayo. That's a guitar player? Yeah, the guitar player. Yeah, the guitar player. And let's see, Johnny, Johnny, he commented on drums. And I play sax and baronet, and there's the, what was it, there's Johnny New Rob. He plays the trumpet and trombone and sings. He does all the vocals. And then he was playing trumpet. At the time Johnny McDonald was playing trumpet but he had to quit because he had a few other commitments out of town having civil service. And a lot of the boys are stop-arsing like Tony Fugera, Martin Tremuto, and is it an English party, Clyde is it? Clyde, yeah. Yeah, he sits in and a few others.
He plays trumpet. He's a good spot and he's a real good man. Gets a beautiful tone too.
Does Hank Bellis ever sit in?
